div.div:
PK id : UUID «v7»
UK email : VARCHAR(320)
password_hash · created_at · updated_at
next_proposal_at : timestamptz «S-05»
null = never scheduled; backup, not a lease
preferred_language : VARCHAR(2) «DEV-49»
null = never chosen, reads as Polish
email_verified_at : timestamptz «DEV-51»
null = never proved; the account cannot log in
verification_code_hash · _expires_at · _attempts

S-07 did NOT create this table.
The current layer went onto goal as a
third layer value + optional due_date.
Split it out only when tasks get their
own lifecycle (recurrence, overdue
alarms) — then a migration, not a rewrite.

div.div:
all three layers
PK id : UUID «v7»
FK user_id → app_user «NO ACTION»
content : VARCHAR(500)
layer : TASK / GOAL / DREAM «discriminator»
horizon : only for GOAL
due_date : only for TASK
FK category_code → category «nullable»
completed_at «null = active»
remind_after «snoozed until, S-04b»
withdrawn_at «null = in play, S-04b»
created_at / updated_at
CHK horizon only on GOAL · due_date only on TASK

div.div:
what the user was shown, and what they answered
PK id : UUID «v7»
FK user_id → app_user «NO ACTION»
FK goal_id → goal «ON DELETE CASCADE»
message : TEXT «the phrased proposal»
neglected_days «frozen at phrasing»
source : LLM / TEMPLATE
answer / answered_at «null = pending; SUPERSEDED is the app's own»
first_step : jsonb «FR-014 bullets»
created_at / updated_at
UK one pending row per user (partial UNIQUE)
